summary: Lane 19 (error handling) on shop.lab.test: both open items were tested and marked done, with evidence attached. WSTG-ERRH-01 (improper error handling): malformed query strings, an invalid percent-encoding, out-of-range and non-numeric ids, and nonexistent paths produced generic responses (bare "not found" 404, stock nginx 400, plain "ok" or {"ok":true}), with no verbose error text. WSTG-ERRH-02 (stack traces): no stack trace or debug output in any response from phpinfo.php, /debug, /.git/HEAD, error-triggering paths, or the linked app.js. Caveats: HTTPS to shop.lab.test was refused at connect, so all testing was over HTTP (recorded as a lead). The request budget (20) ran out during the run, so there was no further coverage, such as non-GET methods (not permitted anyway), more API paths, or deeper malformed-JSON probing on the API. Leads recorded for other lanes: a hardcoded AWS key ID and a Stripe publishable key in static/app.js (medium), a public source map exposing original TypeScript sources (low), search reflecting raw query text (low, not validated), and plain HTTP with no redirect (info). Nothing was validated as a vulnerability in this lane; a person should review the evidence before signing the receipt.
